findings.source_quote: Milky Way and stars above dark mountains and water
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the image alt to a natural Kiswahili rendering of the original meaning, e.g. "Njia ya Maziwa na nyota juu ya milima meusi na maji" (preserve punctuation and tags).
findings.translation_quote: Mwanzo wa Njia ya Maziwa na nyota juu ya milima na maji yaliyo giza

findings.source_quote: Which stretch the mind almost to breaking point
findings.suggested_fix: Use a natural Kiswahili idiom for "breaking point". Suggested revision: "Ambazo zinapanua akili hadi kufikia kiwango cha kuvunjika" or "Ambazo zinapanua akili hadi kufikia ukingo wa kuvunjika".
findings.translation_quote: Unaobana akili hadi kufikia mfereji wa kuvunjika

findings.source_quote: And humbly bow our heads and worship Him.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the correct Kiswahili verb for "bow". Suggested revision: "Na tukokomee vichwa vyetu kwa unyenyekevu na kumwabudu" or "Na tukunjue vichwa vyetu kwa unyenyekevu na kumwabudu." Keep the HTML structure unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: Na kukunjua vichwa vyetu kwa unyenyekevu na kumwabudu.

findings.source_quote: The crescent moon is closer yet to you,
findings.suggested_fix: Use the standard Kiswahili word/phrase for "crescent moon". Suggested revision: "Mwezi wa tone uko karibu zaidi kwako," or "Mwezi mweupe (mwenye umbo la tone) uko karibu zaidi kwako," depending on preferred idiom.
findings.translation_quote: Mwezi wa mninga uko karibu zaidi kwako,
